description: Public JSON Schema contract for the authored documents of a pipeline package: where each sits, read from the pipeline's own directory (the one holding `pipeline.json`), and the published schema it is written against. It holds locations only; each document's shape is the schema it points at. Other files a package carries are outside this schema. Source of truth: analitiq.contracts.pipeline_package.PipelinePackage (Pydantic).
title: Analitiq Pipeline Package
